correctnessFindings.assessment: The history-window builder keeps its existing 16 MiB source allowance but reads through the bounded file reader rather than stat followed by an unbounded readFile.
UTF-8 conversion follows the successful bounded read. Read failure still returns the existing INCONSISTENT result, so unverifiable history is not misrepresented as a valid empty window.

originalReview.userVisibleBeforeAfter: Normal history windows are unchanged. A file growing past the existing 16 MiB allowance during the read now yields the existing inconsistent/unverifiable result.
originalReview.capacityAndDataLoss: Existing source-size contract enforced at read time; no new quota, stored-history deletion, or command cancellation.

platformEvidence.assessment: The change uses the shared portable Node bounded-file reader. Fresh macOS tests cover the read-time bound; native Windows/Linux file races are not independently executed.
platformEvidence.executedHost: Fresh shared batch: macOS darwin arm64; Node 26.6.0. PRs outside that batch have no new execution in this follow-up.

originalReview.sshAndFolderCases: The existing history source stays on its execution host; no remote liveness inference or local-only Git assumption is added. Folder workspaces remain supported by the same file path API.
